<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Amire80" />{{GHGcorrected}}</noinclude><section begin="par85" />{{Hyphenated word end|offering|meal-offering}}) is a ''nomen verbale'' of {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}}, answering to the Aramaic infinitive of the causal stem (''ʾAphʿēl''), hence with suff. {{GHGheb|text=אַזְכָּֽרָתָהּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=2|verse=2}}, &c.

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|c}}
46. Nouns with {{GHGheb|text=ה}} prefixed. Besides the ordinary infinitives of {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הַקְטֵל}} and {{GHGheb|text=הַקְטִיל}}, of {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=הִקָּטֵל}}, {{GHGheb|text=הִקָּטֹל}} (for ''hinq.''), and of the conjugations formed with the prefix {{GHGheb|text=הִתְ}}, this class also includes some rare {{GHGterm|nomina verbalia}} derived from {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}} (cf. {{GHGpar|72|z}}), viz. {{GHGheb|text=הַכָּרָה|translate=appearance}} (from {{GHGheb|text=נָכַר}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=3|verse=9}}; {{GHGheb|text=הֲנָפָה|translate=a swinging}} (from {{GHGheb|text=נוּף}}), [{{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=30|verse=28}}; {{GHGheb|text=הֲנָחָה|translate=a rest-giving}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Est|chapter=2|verse=18}}]; {{GHGheb|text=הַצָּלָה|translate=deliverance}} (from {{GHGheb|text=נָצַל}}), [{{GHGbible-ref|book=Est|chapter=4|verse=14}} an Aram. form: cf. {{GHGheb|text=הֲזָדָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dn|chapter=5|verse=20}}]; perhaps also {{GHGheb|text=הֵיכָל|translate=palace}}, from ''haikăl'', unless it is borrowed from the Assyrian; see the Lexicon. <!-- begin: not listed in the correction list, but makes sense -->Cf. also<!-- end: not listed in the correction list, but makes sense --> {{:Gesenius' Hebrew Grammar/Additions and Corrections/236}}

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|d}}
47. Nouns with {{GHGheb|text=י}} prefixed, as {{GHGheb|text=יִצְהָר|translate=oil}}, {{GHGheb|text=יַלְקוּט|translate=wallet}}, {{GHGheb|text=יַנְשׁוּף|translate=owl}}(?); from verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״וּ}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=יְקוּם|translate=a living thing}}, {{GHGheb|text=יְתוּר|translate=a range}}; from a verb {{GHGheb|text=ע״י}}, {{GHGheb|text=יָרִיב|translate=an adversary}}. Of a different character are the many proper names which have simply adopted the imperfect form, as {{GHGheb|text=יַֽעֲקֹב}}, {{GHGheb|text=יִצְחָק}}, &c.

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|e}}
48. Nouns with {{GHGheb|text=מ‍}} prefixed. This ''preformative Mêm'', which is no doubt connected with {{GHGheb|text=מִי|translate=who}}, and {{GHGheb|text=מָה|translate=what}} (see § 37 and {{GHGpar|52|c}}), appears in a very large number of nouns, and serves to express the most varied modifications of the idea of the stem: (1) {{GHGheb|text=מ‍|translate=subjective}}, when preformative of the participles ''Piʿēl, Hiphʿîl, Hithpaʿēl'', and other active conjugations. (2) {{GHGheb|text=מ‍|translate=objective}}, when preformative of the participles ''Puʿal, Hophʿal'', and other passive conjugations, as well as of numerous nouns. (3) {{GHGheb|text=מ‍|translate=instrumental}}, as in {{GHGheb|text=מַפְתֵּחַ|translate=a key}}, &c. (4) {{GHGheb|text=מ‍|translate=local}}, as in {{GHGheb|text=מִדְבָּר|translate=a drive for cattle}}, &c.

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|f}}
As regards the formation of these nouns, it is to be remarked that the preformative {{GHGheb|text=מ‍}} was originally in most cases followed by a short ''ă''. This ''ă'', however, in a closed syllable is frequently attenuated to ''ĭ''; in an open syllable before the tone it is lengthened to ''ā'' (so also the ''ĭ'', attenuated from ''ă'', is lengthened to ''ē''), and in {{GHGheb|text=מָגֵן|translate=shield}} (with suff. {{GHGheb|text=מָֽגִנִּי}}) it even becomes unchangeable ''â''. But in an open syllable which does ''not'' stand before the tone, the ''a'' necessarily becomes {{GHGterm|Š<sup>e</sup>wâ}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|g}}
The following forms are especially to be noticed: (''a'') ground-form ''măqṭăl'', in Hebrew {{GHGheb|text=מַקְטָל}},<ref>In {{GHGheb|text=מַֽמְתַקִּים}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ct|chapter=5|verse=16}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=8|verse=10}}, the first syllable is artificially opened to avoid the cacophony; on the ''ă'' of the second syllable cf. {{GHGpar|93|ee}}.</ref> e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מַֽאֲכָל|translate=food}}; fem. {{GHGheb|text=מַמְלָכָה|translate=kingdom}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַֽאֲכֶ֫לֶת|translate=a knife}}, {{GHGheb|text=מְלָאכָה}} (for {{GHGheb|text=מַלְאָכָה}} by {{GHGpar|23|c}}) ''business''; from a verb {{GHGheb|text=פ״ן}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַתָּן|translate=a gift}}; from verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״ו}}, {{GHGheb|text=מוֹצָא|translate=a going forth}}, {{GHGheb|text=מוֹשָׁב|translate=a seat}}; from verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״י}}, {{GHGheb|text=מֵיטָב|translate=the best}} (from ''maiṭăb''); with {{GHGheb|text=י}} (or {{GHGheb|text=ו}}) assimilated, {{GHGheb|text=מַצָּע|translate=a bed}}; from verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, {{GHGheb|text=מָסָךְ|translate=a screen}}, and with the shortening of the ''ă'' under the preformative, {{GHGheb|text=מֶ֫מֶר|translate=bitterness}} (from {{GHGheb|text=מְמַר}} developed to a segholate), fem. {{GHGheb|text=מְשַׁמָּה|translate=desolation}}; from a verb {{GHGheb|text=ע״וּ}}, probably of this class is {{GHGheb|text=מָקוֹם|translate=place}}, the ''ă'' lengthened to ''ā'' and obscured to ''ô'' (Arabic ''măqâm''); from verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַרְאֶה|translate=appearance}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַ֫עַן}} (for {{GHGheb|text=מַֽעֲנֶה}}) prop. ''intention'', only in {{GHGheb|text=לְמַ֫עַן|translate=on account of, in order that}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|h}}
(''b'') Ground-form ''miqṭăl'' (the usual form of the infin. {{GHGterm|Qal}} in Aramaic), Hebr. {{GHGheb|text=מִקְטָל}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מִדְבָּר}} (in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=2|verse=31}} also, where Baer requires {{GHGheb|text=הֲמִדְבַּר}}, read with ed. Mant., Ginsburg, &c. {{GHGheb|text=הֲמִדְבָּר}}) ''a cattle-drive'', fem. {{GHGheb|text=מִלְחָמָה|translate=war}}, {{GHGheb|text=מֶרְכָּבָה|translate=a chariot}} (with {{GHGterm|S<sup>e</sup>ghôl}} instead of ''ĭ'', but in ''constr. st.'' {{GHGheb|text=מִרְכֶּ֫בֶת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=41|verse=43}}; cf. {{GHGheb|text=מֶרְחָק|translate=distance}}), {{GHGheb|text=מִשְׁמֶ֫רֶת|translate=a watch}}; from verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מֵסַב|translate=surroundings}} (from ''mĭ-săb''; ''ĭ'' in the open syllable being lengthened to ''ē''; but cf. also {{GHGheb|text=מַשַּׁק}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=33|verse=4}} as {{GHGterm|constr. state}} from {{GHGheb|text=שׁקק}} with sharpening of the first radical; cf. {{GHGpar|67|g}}); from verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}}, {{GHGheb|text=מִקְנֶה|translate=a possession}}, fem. {{GHGheb|text=מִקְנָה}}.
